title: Review of c03's FCH cargo-fission (SIWD): replicated on seed 9 (cargo 785-860x, chi=0 1.1x; 22 persistent splits, gen 4); W is bulk partitioning, recorded as by construction
summary: Verdict written before reading other reviews. I looked at fission_strips_seed1.png and cargo_contrast.txt, re-ran the claimed world unchanged on new seed 9 (rerun/seed9, T=400) and the chi=0 ablation on the same seed (chi0/seed9), and measured contrast with c03's cargo_contrast.py (contrast_*.txt). From white noise the micelles grow and divide: 30 splits, 22 persistent, max generation 4, 0 merges, 61 bodies at t=400. Cargo contrast at frames 90/100: 858x and 785x, all bodies >= 2x, weakest body 79x and 22x; chi=0 on the same seed: 1.1x, no body >= 2x. Daughters keep the cargo (the weakest bodies, at 22x, are the youngest).

verdicts.limitation: The cargo is held by bulk partitioning into the amphiphile-rich core (an imposed potential chi u with chi=-3, giving an equilibrium ratio of order exp(3 du)), not by a boundary layer: there is no wall operator, so W holds by construction of the solubility law rather than by an organized boundary; I record it as by construction. The bodies are filled micelles with no B (the claim does not claim B). Growth is on a uniform open feed. One new seed; resolution check not re-run.
